**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Check the owner role before legacy-media conflicts**

When a listing has a legacy D1 image and its owner is changed from `OWNER` to `ADMIN`, this early check returns `409 LEGACY_MEDIA_MIGRATION_REQUIRED` before the owner-role check can return 404; the publish handler has the same ordering. The queue, detail, and image routes deliberately hide these listings, so the mutation routes expose a listing that the rest of the ADMIN API treats as absent. Resolve and validate the current owner before checking legacy media.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L127-L130](https://github.com/sjo1848/alquileres-uspa-cloudflare/blob/8232718efbb199fa71bc730e06750d193ce2d1da/AGENTS.md#L127-L130)
